meta.promptText: India mein 2000 rupees ke andar men ke liye konse brand ki jeans kharidni chahiye?

response.text:
Haan — **₹2,000 ke andar men’s jeans ke liye main sabse pehle Levi’s aur Pepe Jeans dekhunga**, especially sale mein. Current listings ke hisaab se kaafi achhe options budget ke andar mil rahe hain. [www.pepejeans.in](https://www.pepejeans.in/men/jeans?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Meri ranking 👖

1. **Levi’s — Best overall**
   - Sale mein **₹1,200–₹1,900** ke aas-paas 511/513/505 jaise fits mil sakte hain.
   - Quality + fitting + durability ke liye meri **#1 choice**.
   - Current example: Levi’s 511 around ₹1,279 aur 505 around ₹1,899.  
   [Levi's Men's 511 Slim Fit Jeans]()
   [Levi's 505 Straight Fit Men Mid Rise Jeans]()

2. **Pepe Jeans — Best value**
   - Abhi official site par kuch straight-fit jeans **₹1,499** aur ₹1,999 tak mil rahi hain. [www.pepejeans.in](https://www.pepejeans.in/men/jeans?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - Agar **comfortable + stylish + premium-looking** jeans chahiye, excellent choice.
   [Pepe Jeans Men's Holborne Mid Rise Straight Jeans]()

3. **H&M — Best for modern/relaxed style**
   - ₹1,399–₹1,999 range mein options mil rahe hain.
   - Relaxed/straight fit pasand hai toh consider karo.
   [Men H&M Denim Relaxed Jeans]()

4. **Flying Machine — Best budget option**
   - Generally **₹1,000–₹1,500** mein achhe options.
   - Daily college/casual wear ke liye paisa vasool. [magicpin.in](https://magicpin.in/blog/category/fashion/top-jeans-brands-in-india-men?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   [Flying Machine Men's Jackson Skinny Fit Jeans]()

5. **Spykar — Stretch/comfort ke liye**
   - Sale mein ₹1,500–₹2,000 ke andar mil sakti hai; stretch denim ke options kaafi hain. [magicpin.in](https://magicpin.in/blog/category/fashion/top-jeans-brands-in-india-men?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### 💰 Agar mere ₹2,000 hote:
**Levi’s > Pepe Jeans > H&M > Spykar > Flying Machine**

Aur **fit sabse important hai**:  
- Slim body → **511 / slim fit**
- Normal/average body → **straight fit**
- Thighs heavy ya comfort chahiye → **relaxed/straight fit**
- Skinny jeans avoid karna ho → straight/relaxed best.

Agar tum **apni height + weight + waist size** bata do, main ₹2,000 ke andar **3-5 exact jeans/models** suggest kar sakta hoon jo tumhare body type par best lagenge.
